children: Boeing said on September 2 local time that it delivered the last three satellites in SES's O3b mPOWER constellation — F11, F12 and F13 — completing delivery of the project's first 13-satellite batch, according to Jiemian News. The three satellites are scheduled to launch from Florida's Space Coast in September and are expected to enter service in mid-2027 after orbit-raising and initialization. O3b mPOWER operates in medium Earth orbit and provides low-latency, high-throughput, dedicated-bandwidth connectivity for government agencies, mobile operators, airlines and cruise lines.

title: Boeing Delivers Final 3 O3b mPOWER Satellites to SES
